PNG to JPG Converter

Convert PNG images to smaller JPG files with adjustable quality and a custom background color for transparent areas. Batch convert and download as a ZIP.

🖼️ Drop PNG files here or click to browse
    FileOriginalJPG sizeSaved

    JPG has no transparency — transparent areas are filled with your chosen background color. Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

    📖 How to use

    1. Drop one or more PNG files into the upload zone.
    2. Pick a background color for transparent areas and set the JPEG quality (10–100).
    3. Click “Convert to JPG” and review the per-file size savings.
    4. Download each JPG individually or all together as a ZIP.

    ❓ Frequently asked questions

    What happens to transparency?

    JPG does not support transparency, so any transparent pixels are filled with the background color you pick (white by default).

    Which quality should I choose?

    Around 85 looks great for photos. Below 70 you may see blocky artifacts; 95 is near-lossless but much larger.

    Is there a size limit?

    No — everything runs locally in your browser via the canvas API. No uploads, no watermarks, no limits.
